title: AI Lead Scorer
description: List company websites and describe who you sell to. Each website is read, scored 0-10 against your description with quoted, linked evidence, and each company that fits gets an opening line for a cold email. You pay only for companies whose website could be read and scored.

websites.title: Company websites
websites.description: One domain or URL per line, e.g. acme.com. Duplicates are removed.

datasetId.title: Or a dataset from another Actor run
datasetId.description: Scores the website (or domain, or url) of every item, e.g. results from Google Maps Scraper or a company-list Actor. Employee count, industry, country and funding fields are used as facts.

idealCustomer.title: Who you sell to
idealCustomer.description: Describe your ideal customer in plain words: what they do, who they sell to, and what makes them need you now.
idealCustomer.prefill: B2B software companies that sell to sales, marketing or growth teams and are hiring or have recently raised money, so they will soon need more pipeline.

industries.title: Industries
industries.description: Optional, e.g. B2B SaaS, fintech. Companies clearly outside these score 4 or less.

minEmployees.title: Minimum employees
minEmployees.description: Optional. Websites rarely state headcount; see 'Hold back unknown size or stage'.

countries.title: Countries or regions
countries.description: Optional, e.g. United States, United Kingdom.

buyingSignals.title: Reasons to reach out now
buyingSignals.description: What makes a company worth contacting now. Each one found is quoted from the page it came from, with its date.
default: hiring sales, marketing or growth roles
raised funding in the last 12 months
launched a new product or entered a new market

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Optional, e.g. agencies, consumer apps. Excluded companies score 4 or less.

minScore.title: Minimum score to qualify
minScore.description: Companies at or above this score (and judged a fit) are marked qualified and get an opening line.

requireSizeOrStage.title: Hold back unknown size or stage
requireSizeOrStage.description: When you set employees or funding stages and neither can be found, the company stays one point below the minimum score, marked for a manual check. A dataset with employee counts avoids this.

offer.title: What you sell
offer.description: Optional, one line, e.g. 'researched lead lists for new growth teams'. Opening lines stay relevant to it without pitching.

writeOpeningLines.title: Write opening lines
writeOpeningLines.description: One line per qualified company, about one verified fact, checked for length, banned phrases and copied text.

maxCompanies.title: Max companies
maxCompanies.description: Only the first this many companies are scored.

maxPagesPerCompany.title: Pages read per company
maxPagesPerCompany.description: The homepage plus careers, news, about and customer pages when linked.
